transcript: Speaker A: ये कौन सी दवाई दे दी है तूने? पर्चे में तो कुछ और ही लिखा है। कितनी बार समझाऊँ, तेरे दिमाग में कुछ घुसता क्यों नहीं? अगर English नहीं आती तो medical store पे काम क्यों करने चला आया गवार कहीं का चल भाग यहाँ से। [What medicine have you given? Something else is written in the prescription. How many times should I explain, why doesn't anything go into your brain? If you don't know English, why did you come to work at a medical store, you illiterate, get out of here.] Speaker B: Sir, please don't talk to me like that. This is not my mistake. It's a doctor's mistake and he is the one who wrote it incorrectly. I will give the medicine according to what is written on the prescription. And yes I am not uneducated. I have three years of experience in pharma. Please speak respectfully from now on. Speaker A: अरे तुम तो अच्छी English बोलते हो, कहाँ से सीखा? [Oh, you speak good English, where did you learn?] Speaker B: सर जब मैंने इस फील्ड में कदम रखा तभी पता था इंग्लिश जरूरी है। लेकिन इतना पैसा नहीं था कि कोई कोर्स ज्वाइन कर पाऊं। टाइम भी नहीं था जल्दी जॉब करके पैसा कमाना था। इसलिए मैंने सिर्फ एक रुपये से इंग्लिश सीखी। [Sir, when I stepped into this field, I knew English was important. But I didn't have enough money to join a course. I didn't have time either, I had to get a job quickly and earn money. That's why I learned English for just one rupee.] Speaker A: सिर्फ ₹1 से? कैसे? [For just ₹1? There was a one-rupee trial, I thought what's there to lose with one rupee, let's try. 15 minutes before leaving for office in the morning. Practice with AI coach after returning at night. If I spoke wrong, she corrected me. Never made fun of me, never looked down on me. Specifically learned medical line English, have been using it continuously for the last 6 months. You can see the improvement yourself.] Speaker A: बढ़िया है यार, ऐप का नाम क्या बताया था? [Great, what did you say the app name was?] Speaker B: English Seekho. Speaker A: मैं भी अपने बेटे के लिए डाउनलोड करता हूँ। [I will also download it for my son.] Voiceover: Install Now पे क्लिक करो और अभी English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [Click on Install Now and download the English Seekho app now.]
on_screen_text: ये कौन सी दवाई दे दी है तूने? [What medicine have you given?] English Seekho. Install Now. [Disclaimer text about English Seekho not being affiliated with government authorities and results varying based on individual effort.]
summary: An angry customer insults a pharmacist for allegedly not knowing English, but is surprised when the pharmacist responds in fluent English. The pharmacist explains he learned English using the English Seekho app's 1-rupee trial. Impressed, the customer decides to download the app for his son.
